title: Trump Announces $5,000 to US Adults if GOP Wins Midterms
description:
“Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - The China Show opens
00:01:20 - Bessent's $6B Treasury buyback plan disappoints investors
00:06:08 - RNC convention kicks off in Dallas
00:12:26 - China seeks talks after US AI theft claims
00:18:21 - Apple enters the foldable phone market with iPhone duo
00:26:29 - Upstage's Hwalsuk Lee on partnerships with AMD and Cerebras
00:36:29 - Breaking: BOJ's Kazuyuki Masu calls for more rate hikes
00:39:34 - China tech firms turn to stock sales to fund AI spending
00:53:46 - Traders brace for 10-year treasury sale
00:56:57 - IBKR's David Friedland on risk appetite after Korea market swings
01:10:41 - Tuttle Capital's Matthew Tuttle on demand for exotic ETFs
01:20:30 - Iran said to be ready to escalate the war
01:24:48 - Axis Bank's Amitabh Chaudhry on AI's impact on jobs
